content: Kuɓari ku Kashila̱

Tsa̱ ta̱ n ama ɗa aꞌa̱ri iryoci i upityanangu ushani a ukyawan. Adama a nala a̱sa̱ka̱i tsu sumai kalambale ka ka̱ri a kapala ka tsunu kotsu tsu shamgba wa. Tsu takpa asuvu a uma u tsunu gba̱ ili iꞌya ya ka̱ngu tsu uyan ili iꞌya i gain tsu yain; wata, unyushi u cingi u ɗa wa fuɗa u gonuko tsu a kucina̱.

U ka̱na̱ ta̱ tsu zuwa aꞌeshi a tsunu a asu u Yesu, uza ɗa wa̱ri kagita̱ ka upityanangu u tsunu, uza ɗa kpam u gonukoi u ɗa tyoku ɗa u gain u woko. U soi mavura, kpam u kuwa̱i a mawandamgbani. Shegai u wushuki n uwono yavu ili i roku iꞌya wa, adama a maza̱nga̱ ma wa tsa̱ra̱ a kapala. Gogo‑na wa̱ ɗe ndishi a ulyaki u karatsu ka tsugono tsu Kashila̱.
Yawunsai n iryoci i Yesu uza ɗa u kawunki an aza a cingi a yanka yi tsicingi. Kotsu i wowo wa, lyayi pini kapala.
Kumoɗu ku ɗe n unyushi u cingi ku rawa a wuna ɗa̱ wa.
Kotsu i a̱sa̱nsa̱ wa an Tagara̱da u Kashila̱ u tonukoi mmuku n ne tsa̱ra̱ u gbamatangusu le atakasuvu:

content.text: Magono ma Zuba ma yanka vu baci kuɓari.
Kotsu vu wutukpa̱ uma wa, wa ɓongo vu baci.
Kpaci Magono ma Zuba ma tsu ɓara ta̱ aza ɗa wa ciga,
kpam u yanka gba̱ aza ɗa u wushunki a woko mmuku n ne mavura.”

content: Kawunki n mavura ma ya so, kpaci icun u mavura ma Tata ma. Maku ma̱ la ma tata u ne u kpa̱ɗa̱i uyan mavura wa. Kirana ɗa Kashila̱ ka kirana n a̱ɗa̱ tyoku mmuku n ne.
Kashila̱ ka tsu yanka ta̱ gba̱ mmuku n ne kuɓari, kpam u kpa̱ɗa̱ vu baci uɓarana u wenike ta̱ maku ma kateshe ma va̱ri, avu maku ma ne ma wa.
Gba̱ tsunu tsa̱ ta̱ n isheku pini na a likimba aza ɗa a tsu ɓara tsu, kpam tsu tsu na̱ka̱ le ta̱ tsupige. U la tsulobo tsu na̱ka̱ Tata u uma u tsunu tsupige tsa̱ra̱ tsu yain uma wa?
Isheku i tsunu i likimba a tsu ɓara tsu ta̱ a aꞌayin kenu a ure u ɗa a wenei wa̱ri dere. Shegai Kashila̱ ka tsu ɓara tsu ta̱ tsa̱ra̱ u ɓa̱nga̱ tsu tsu woko uwulukpi tyoku ɗa wa̱ri.

Kuɓari ka̱ la ka ku yankpai aꞌayin a ɗa a ka yan ka wa, ka̱ ta̱ na̱ mɓa̱la̱! Aꞌayin a ɗa baci Kashila̱ ka yan le mavura tsa̱ra̱ u wenike le ili iꞌya a yain i gan wa, kotsu a rotsongusu a yain dere kpam a rongo na̱ ndishi n shinga.
Pana̱kai Kashila̱
I woko ta̱ usorukpi, adama a nala doki kpam i gbamatangu kaci ka ɗe.
Lapulukai kaci ka ɗe ure mai. Tsa̱ra̱ aza ɗa a ka tono ɗa̱ a ta̱ɗa̱tsa̱ wa, ko an u wokoi aꞌa̱ri awunu n usorukpi u ikyamba tsa̱ra̱ a tsa̱ra̱ ucira.
I ma̱tsa̱ i rongo na̱ ndishi n shinga n ama gba̱, kpam i ma̱tsa̱ i rongo n uwulukpi. Uza ɗa baci dem bawu uma u ne wa̱ri uwulukpi, wa wene Magono ma Zuba wa.
Kiranai tsa̱ra̱ uza u namba ukuna u shinga u Kashila̱ wa. Kiranai kotsu kami ka ahali a cingi ka yain a asuvu a ɗe wa. Icun i nala yi ya nangasa ta̱ ama a asuvu a ɗe ushani.

Kiranai kotsu uza u te u ɗe u yain tsishankala wa, ko tani u ꞌyuwan utono Kashila̱ tyoku ɗa Isuwa yain wa. Isuwa ɗa maku ma pige ma Ishaku, kpam wa̱ri wa tsa̱ ta̱ gba̱ ili iꞌya tata u le wa̱ri n iꞌya, shegai u dengei iꞌya a una̱ u kapara ka kpayan.

I ciɓa ta̱ an Isuwa yain ili i na yi, wa̱ri wa ciga tata u le u zuwuka yi una̱ u shinga, shegai tata u ne u ꞌyuwain. Kpam ili iꞌa̱ la wa yan u savaɗa ukuna vi wa, ko an u foloi tata u ne n kushen n meshi.
Eɗa̱ tyoku u aza a Isaraꞌila aza ɗa a tuwa̱i a Masasa ma Sinai† ɗa iꞌa̱ri wa, a asu u ɗa a ka wene kpam a sawa. Ma̱ri ura̱na n akina, karimbi ka kimba̱i ma da̱n n kabatara̱kpa.
A panai mawura̱ ma kavana n kala̱ga̱tsu. An ama a panai kala̱ga̱tsu a foloi Kashila̱ ka a̱sa̱ka̱ kadyanshi,
kpaci a fuɗa a kawunku wa, an u danai, “Ko manama ma baci ma sawai masasa mi, u ka̱na̱ ta̱ a vara̱sa ma a wuna.”
Musa n kaci ka ne dem u giruwa̱ ta̱ cika adama a ili iꞌya u wenei an u danai, “N pana ta̱ uwonvo cika kpam ma jeke ikyamba.”

Shegai gogo‑na i tuwa̱ ɗe a Masasa ma Sihiyona, ilyuci i pige i Kashila̱ Uza u Uma n Urishelima u ɗa wa̱ri a zuba. Wata, a asu u atsumate a zuba a ɗa kakuma̱ ka le bawu ka̱ri ukece a ɓolomgbonoi a yain ipeli.

I tuwa̱ ta̱ a asu u kaɓolo ka mmuku n Kashila̱ yavu gba̱ ɗe mmuku n kagita̱ n ne n ɗa aꞌa̱ri. A korongu ta̱ aꞌala a le gba̱ a zuba. I tuwa̱i a asu u Kashila̱ uza u afada u ama gba̱. Kpam i tuwa̱i a asu u aꞌulu a aza a maci aza ɗa a kuwa̱i caupa, kpam Kashila̱ ka gonuko le tyoku ɗa wa ciga le a woko.
I rawa ɗe asu u Yesu, kaꞌuwi ka mere ka kazuwamgbani ka savu a asu u Kashila̱ n ama. Mpasa n Yesu n ɗa a vishana̱sai tyoku u uɗara̱kpa n ɗa ma̱ri n akani a ɗa a lai mpasa n Habila.

Adama a nala, kiranai kpam kotsu i ꞌyuwan upana̱ka Kashila̱ wa, aꞌayin a ɗa baci wa dansa. Aza a Isaraꞌila a ꞌyuwan yi upana̱ka an u rono le atsuvu aꞌayin a ɗa aꞌa̱ri a likimba, kpam a la wa. Adama a nala, u tsunu wa la ta̱ tsu kpatala̱ka baci Kashila̱ uza ɗa wa̱ri a zuba kucina̱ an wa rono tsu atsuvu.
An u yain kadyanshi caupa, kala̱ga̱tsu ka ne ka gba̱ɗa̱ ta̱ likimba, shegai gogo‑na u yan ta̱ kazuwamgbani, “Ma doku ta̱ kpam n gba̱ɗa̱ kuten, shegai likimba ɗa koshi wa, hal n zuba dem.”
An u danai nala, ili iꞌya wa tono iꞌya na, wa wacinsa ta̱ gba̱ ili iꞌya u yain. Ili iꞌya bawu a ka gba̱ɗa̱ iꞌya koshi ya woko.
Ili iꞌya i zuwai tsa cikpa iꞌya, an tsu tsa̱ra̱i tsugono tsa bawu tsa gba̱ɗa̱ u ɗa. She tsu lyaka Kashila̱ kayala a ure u ɗa wa pana kayanyan kpam n una̱ka̱ karinga̱ u pige n uwonvo,
kpaci Kashila̱ ka tsunu ka̱ ta̱ tyoku u akina a kasuɗugbate ɗa a ka wacinsa ili.

footnotes.text: An Kayinu wunai vangu u ne Habila, Kashila̱ ka dana ta̱, “Mpasa n vangu u vunu n ɗa ma̱ri a iyamba n tuko ta̱ kushen ara va̱” (Kagita̱ 4:10). Mpasa n Yesu n tuko ta̱ ucimbusa̱ u unyushi u cingi, shegai mpasa n Habila ma̱ri ma ciga ta̱ a yain uza ɗa u wuna yi mavura.
